page.overview:
Who is Kal'Falnl C'ndros?

Kal'Falnl C'ndros (sometimes known as Kal Fal) was a female Quor'sav trader.

Kal'Falnl C'ndros was a 3.5 meter tall freelance pilot, whose size required her to own a custom-built ship, the Shelltooth, with corridors tall enough to accommodate her. She was widely regarded as being an overprotective mother, and her maternal instincts included not only her own eggs but also her clients and friends, especially the Bimm trader Rycar Ryjerd. Her brood of eggs was scooped out by Kitik Keed'kak, a Yam'rii female, with covetous intent.

For a time after picking him up at a stopover on Yuvern, C'ndros trained the young Yuvernian Cane Adiss how to pilot starships. They visited dozens of worlds before going their separate ways on Tatooine.

She was wandering in the streets of Mos Eisley while Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were selling Luke's old X-34 landspeeder to Vuvrian alien Wioslea.
